initiative.title: Workspace layout on disk
initiative.summary: Make the planning workspace folder layout deliberate (tasks as folders, a clear home for reference and topics) and move existing workspaces with one migrate command.
initiative.next_action: Build m1: public/layout.js and plan-viewer migrate

sources.anchor: folder listing: no plans/, reference/ mixes JSON config and prose
round 1: task folder, config home, topics, daily
round 2: notes stay in reference/notes, tool md to config, dry run then --write agent-friendly, sidebar
round 3: old links break; migrate behavior confirmed

claims.statement: The folder layout should be deliberate and explainable to a new user.
A task and its assets should probably live in one folder.
Reference files and topics feel misplaced; the sidebar placement of topics is unexplained.
Existing workspaces move with a one-shot migrate command; the viewer reads only the new layout.
Layout is its own initiative and lands before TASK-0038 and TASK-0040 build on it.

shape.appetite: a few days of agent work; stack of four PRs
shape.problem: Workspace folders are haphazard: task split across file and assets folder, reference mixes prose and tool data, topics unexplained.
shape.recommended_shape: tasks/TASK-NNNN/ folders, flat daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md, config/ for tool data, reference/ prose only, topics dropped; shared public/layout.js; agent-friendly plan-viewer migrate.
success_moves: Migrate built and proven before any reader switches
Demo and fixtures converted by migrate itself
Every blocker message carries a fix hint so an agent can loop
Migrate verifies every link still resolves

first_proof.question: Can migrate convert the demo with every link resolving?
first_proof.artifact: migrate.test.ts on a temp copy of examples/workspace
first_proof.decision_rule: If any link breaks, fix the rewrite before switching readers.

fast_local_loop.command: npm test -- migrate.test.ts && node cli.ts migrate
